evals.name: full-migration
evals.prompt: I want to switch this project's test suite from pytest to rstest so it runs in parallel and faster. Can you migrate it and make sure it still passes?
evals.expected_output: Detects the project, runs rstest -n 0 (contract), runs --migrate-check, finds the uuid-based unstable parametrize id in tests/test_params.py, fixes it with a stable ids=, gets to a green -n auto run, and reports the result. Should NOT just leave the suite on -n 0.

evals.name: why-fails-parallel
evals.prompt: My pytest tests all pass, but when I try rstest it complains about the test set and won't run in parallel. What's wrong and can you fix it?
evals.expected_output: Identifies the unstable nodeid (uuid in the parametrize id of tests/test_params.py) as the cause of the dispatch bail, explains it forces -n 0, fixes it with stable ids=, and confirms parallel now works.

evals.name: is-it-ready
evals.prompt: Is this test suite ready to run in parallel? I'd like to know before I commit to switching runners.
evals.expected_output: Runs rstest --migrate-check (the preflight), reports that the suite is NOT ready due to the uuid unstable id, names the offending parametrize site and the fix (stable ids=). Diagnosis-first; may offer to apply the fix but the core is an accurate readiness report.
